portable_principle: A language-native compiler can establish narrow static identity and relationship facts, but each skill must preserve the gap between those facts and behavioral or lifecycle conclusions.

final_outcomes.semantic_detector: confirmed, uncertain, and rejected function-level review leads plus capability matrices
final_outcomes.shadow_consumer: validated read-only proposal, evidence, and scope artifacts
final_outcomes.rename_assessment: lexical lifecycle gate plus resolved Go declaration/reference classifications

reuse_decision.next_abstraction_gate: Extract only bootstrap/path behavior after one real cross-consumer repair demonstrates a maintenance benefit and the on-demand closure can carry it explicitly.

known_limits: top-level functions and direct named-struct composite returns only for semantic duplication
methods, interface dispatch, reflection, framework behavior, side-effect equivalence, and safe refactoring remain unavailable
unify-shadows trusts only one complete confirmed upstream record and does no re-detection
rename authority is limited to matching exported package-scope declarations
inactive build-constrained sources block downstream certification
next_gate: Fresh product-framed review, preservation suite, copied-closure replay, then per-skill capability promotion.
